inputs.description: the source definition: one symbol and one month of ticks, one price side per run when the source asks for one

source.description: {symbol, month, side (bid | ask | both), price_scale, instrument, licence}

price_scale.description: digits after the point in the symbol's Dukascopy prices: 5 for EURUSD, 3 for XAUUSD and USDJPY

instrument.description: the symbol's Dukascopy instrument record; its digits must equal price_scale

check.description: a landed series' dataset card: fetch nothing, and report wrong_scale when its price_scale is not the source's

dry_run.description: check the step and download nothing

outputs.description: the partition this run landed: its key, rows, fingerprint, whether the month is frozen, and the card's volume label
